cli_telemetry.last_assistant_text:
The submission is confirmed as triggered with `analysis_valid: true`. The PoC is `poc_i32.wasm` (27 bytes) — a minimal wasm module with a single `i32.const 1; drop; end` function body.

The vulnerability is an unsigned integer negation overflow at `wasm_loader.c:9718` in `wasm_loader_get_const_offset`. The expression `-(uint32)(ctx->i32_const_num)` negates a nonzero unsigned 32-bit value, which is undefined behavior detected by UBSan. Any wasm module with at least one numeric constant (i32, i64, f32, or f64) triggers this during the second pass of fast-interpreter bytecode preparation, when the constant's offset is computed.
